description: Source code for the GLImageIOSurface class, handling IOSurface-based image representations on macOS, including initialization, size retrieval, and memory dumping.

classes.name: GLImageIOSurface
classes.description: A class representing an image backed by an IOSurface on macOS, providing creation, initialization, size retrieval, and memory dumping functionalities.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new GLImageIOSurface instance based on the current GL implementation.

methods.name: GetSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the IOSurface image.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the GLImageIOSurface with a given IOSurface, plane, shared memory ID, and format.

methods.name: InitializeWithCVPixelBuffer
methods.description: Initializes the GLImageIOSurface from a CVPixelBufferRef.

methods.name: OnMemoryDump
methods.description: Performs memory dump operations for profiling, including size and GUID associations.
